'''Kaellus Fane's armor''' was a famous set of armor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] hero [[Kaellus Fane]] that was valued by collectors. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oma'gorek]] sought to acquire the complete armor, and his hired agents located the final piece&mdash;the gauntlets&mdash;in an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] scrap yard before they were incinerated.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Heroic Memorabilia}}</ref>
